# Mapping Specification: SUPPORT_TICKETS

**Source file:** data/raw/support_tickets.csv
**Data source name:** SUPPORT_TICKETS
**Entity type:** Person
**Generated by:** mapping_workflow

## Field Mappings

| Source Field | Senzing Attribute | Transformation | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| ticket_id | RECORD_ID (root) | none | stable unique key; not a feature |
| (constant) | DATA_SOURCE = SUPPORT_TICKETS (root) | constant | |
| (constant) | RECORD_TYPE = PERSON | constant | tickets are filed by individual customers |
| name | NAME_FULL | none | single name field; never parsed; original casing kept |
| email | EMAIL_ADDRESS | none | |
| subject | payload `subject` (root) | none | ticket category; carried, not matched |
| opened_date | (not emitted) | — | date column left out |

Empty values are omitted; no empty feature objects are written.

## Mapping Decisions

- One PERSON master keyed by `ticket_id`; repeat tickets from the same person stay separate records for Senzing to resolve.
- `subject` and `opened_date` follow the Bootcamper's CRM_SYSTEM decisions for a category column (payload) and a date column (ignored).
